images.scene: SCIENTIFIC SCHEMATIC: measuring methane with reflected sunlight. Left two-thirds of picture contains a simple Sun at upper-left, one small generic industrial site on a horizontal ground strip at lower-centre, and a compact cuboid satellite with two solar-panel wings at upper-right of the SCENE (around 62% of the entire picture width), clearly high above ground. SUNLIGHT PATH: a single OCHRE dashed diagonal from the Sun to the GROUND near the industrial site, with THREE LARGE ARROWHEADS along it ALL pointing DOWN and RIGHT toward the ground, marker 1 beside it. REFLECTED LIGHT PATH: a separate GREEN dashed diagonal STARTING AT THAT SAME GROUND POINT and ending at the satellite sensor, with THREE LARGE ARROWHEADS ALL pointing UP and RIGHT toward the satellite, marker 2 beside it. No arrow goes from satellite to ground; satellite emits no light. Just above ground, a thin DASHED ELLIPTICAL OUTLINE encloses the lower part of the reflected path. This marks invisible methane only: NO visible cloud, fog, smoke, tinted gas, molecules, plume or filled oval. Marker 3 beside satellite indicates spectrometer. Right third separated by ample ivory whitespace contains a clean small INSET SPECTRUM GRAPH with horizontal wavelength axis pointing right and vertical received-light axis pointing up, and one green line with three downward absorption dips that stay WELL ABOVE the horizontal zero baseline. No axis labels, ticks with numbers, quantities or measured-data claims; website supplies labels and explanation. Conceptual positions and distances not to scale. Entire illustration must clearly teach DOWNWARD solar illumination then UPWARD reflected passive measurement. Make arrowheads and empty methane-outline region especially legible, scientific arrangement has priority over decorative detail.

Three bold forest-green arrows connect group1→group2→group3→group4, all arrowheads face RIGHT. In the lower third a spacious single feedback-arrow line runs FROM group4 DOWN, LEFT beneath all groups, then UP toward group1, with repeated chevrons facing LEFT along its bottom segment and an UPWARD arrowhead at its destination. The return loop represents monitoring informing future care. No success checkmark, exploding population chart, numerical outcomes, chains or habitat outside prairie. Keep each visual group large, distinct and legible within one unified screenprinted graphic novel instructional composition; no rectangular panel borders. Only digits 1,2,3,4 appear once each, no words.
